Data Classification
Sangha and Education Data Platform
Item | Details
Purpose | Field-level classification, visibility, public projection, retention, minimisation, and access-logging design.
Scope | Synthetic fictional data only. The catalogue covers the logical fields proposed by the current Project Charter and Detailed Requirements.
Document status | Proposal — not a compliance determination or approval to process real data.
Architecture alignment | Confirmed — protected Next.js routes/server actions, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Auth.js, server-side policy and scope filtering, private object storage.
Verification method | Planned public API privacy tests plus catalogue coverage check. No product privacy test is claimed as executed.

Classification describes confidentiality handling, not a statement that any field may lawfully be collected or published. A field classified Public is only eligible for a reviewed public projection; it is not public by default.
Status Labels
Label | Meaning
Confirmed | Constraint established by the work request, Project Charter, Detailed Requirements, or approved architecture.
Proposal | Design choice requiring owner confirmation before implementation.
Needs Legal Review | Real-data, public release, retention, notice, official-status, or similar governance decision requiring DPO or legal review.

Classification Rules
Class | Handling rule
Public | May appear only in a reviewed public projection after all release gates pass. It must never include protected identifiers, audit data, free text, or relationship keys.
Internal | Available only to authenticated staff roles with a server-authorised business purpose. Not disclosed through public APIs.
Restricted | Available only to role-and-scope-authorised users. Exclude from public projection, default logs, exports, and unauthorised analytics.
Highly Restricted | Available only to explicitly authorised roles and narrow scope. Never public. Redact or tokenise in operational logs and treat free text as exceptional.

Confirmed — every protected field read, create, update, export, and history query is authorised on the server. UI visibility, query parameters, and client claims do not grant access.
1 Logical Field Catalogue
All table and field names are proposed logical schema names. Any new field must receive a class, visibility, retention treatment, and public-projection decision before merge.
Organisation and status
Entity | Field | Class | Default visibility | Public projection rule | Classification rationale
Organisation | organisation_id | Internal | Scoped administrative roles | Never public | Technical identifier; do not expose as a public correlation key.
Organisation | synthetic_marker | Internal | Data Steward; System Administrator | Never public | Control field proving the record belongs to the synthetic environment.
Organisation | organisation_code | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Public candidate only via projection | May identify an organisational record; not release-authorised in this phase.
Organisation | display_name | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Public candidate only via projection | No real organisation asserted; release requires owner and legal/DPO gate.
Organisation | organisation_type | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Public candidate only via projection | May expose unverified structural information.
Organisation | parent_organisation_id | Internal | Scoped directory roles | Never public | Relationship key; public view must not infer unpublished hierarchy.
Organisation | current_status | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Never public until official-status review | Status is explicitly not an official assertion in this phase.
OrganisationStatusEvent | event_id | Internal | Scoped directory roles; Security Reviewer | Never public | Technical event reference.
OrganisationStatusEvent | prior_status; new_status; effective_date | Restricted | Scoped directory roles; Security Reviewer | Never public | Operational decision history.
OrganisationStatusEvent | reason | Highly Restricted | Authorised reviewer; Security Reviewer | Never public | Free text or rationale can reveal sensitive context; minimise and redact by default.

Leadership secretary and institution assignments
Entity | Field | Class | Default visibility | Public projection rule | Classification rationale
LeadershipAppointment | appointment_id | Internal | Scoped directory roles | Never public | Technical identifier.
LeadershipAppointment | synthetic_person_ref | Highly Restricted | Scoped directory roles only | Never public | Synthetic today, but treated as sensitive correlation field to prevent future leakage.
LeadershipAppointment | role_taxonomy_code | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Public candidate only via projection | Publication depends on confirmed taxonomy and release gate.
LeadershipAppointment | organisation_id; start_date; end_date | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Public candidate only as approved projection | Relationship and term data may reveal sensitive operational structure.
LeadershipAppointment | appointment_reason | Highly Restricted | Authorised reviewer; Security Reviewer | Never public | Decision rationale must be minimised and protected.
SecretaryAssignment | assignment_id; target_type; target_id; effective_dates | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Never public | Assignment relationship and dates are operational data.
SecretaryAssignment | synthetic_secretary_ref; reason | Highly Restricted | Scoped directory roles only | Never public | Sensitive correlation field and free-text rationale.
InstitutionLeadershipAssignment | assignment_id; institution_id; position_label; term_dates | Restricted | Scoped directory roles | Public candidate only via approved projection | Operational role information; no release is authorised now.
InstitutionLeadershipAssignment | synthetic_head_ref; reason | Highly Restricted | Scoped directory roles only | Never public | Sensitive correlation field and rationale.

Exam centres
Entity | Field | Class | Default visibility | Public projection rule | Classification rationale
ExamCentre | exam_centre_id; synthetic_marker | Internal | Exam Operations; Data Steward | Never public | Technical key and synthetic control.
ExamCentre | centre_code; display_name; linked_organisation_id | Restricted | Exam Operations within scope | Public candidate only via projection | Centre identity and relationships are not approved for public release.
ExamCentre | stated_capacity; current_status | Restricted | Exam Operations within scope | Never public until owner review | Operational capacity and status may be sensitive or misleading if published.
ExamCentreStatusEvent | event_id; prior_status; new_status; effective_date | Restricted | Exam Operations; Security Reviewer | Never public | Lifecycle history.
ExamCentreStatusEvent | reason | Highly Restricted | Authorised reviewer; Security Reviewer | Never public | Free-text rationale.

Applicant and application workflow
Entity | Field | Class | Default visibility | Public projection rule | Classification rationale
Application | application_id; synthetic_marker | Internal | Applicant Services and Exam Operations within scope | Never public | Technical identifier and synthetic control.
Application | synthetic_applicant_ref | Highly Restricted | Self-service scope or authorised operations only | Never public | Must not become a public correlator even while fictional.
Application | programme_or_exam_ref; selected_centre_id | Restricted | Applicant Services and Exam Operations within scope | Never public | Application choices and selected centre are operational data.
Application | declaration_flag; current_status; submitted_at | Highly Restricted | Applicant Services and authorised reviewers | Never public | Workflow state and declarations need heightened protection.
ApplicationStatusEvent | event_id; prior_status; new_status; timestamp | Highly Restricted | Authorised reviewers; Security Reviewer | Never public | Review history can reveal case outcome.
ApplicationStatusEvent | review_reason; reviewer_note | Highly Restricted | Authorised reviewers; Security Reviewer | Never public | Free text disabled by default where structured values suffice.

Identity access and audit
Entity | Field | Class | Default visibility | Public projection rule | Classification rationale
UserAccount | account_id | Highly Restricted | System Administrator only | Never public | Identity-linked technical account reference.
RoleAssignment | role_code; scope_ref; effective_dates | Restricted | System Administrator; Product Owner approval path | Never public | Access posture and scope relationships.
RoleAssignment | affected_account_id; change_reason; session_invalidation_outcome | Highly Restricted | System Administrator; Security Reviewer | Never public | Identity correlation and security event context.
AuditLog | audit_id; request_id; timestamp; action; entity_type | Internal | Security Reviewer; scoped authorised roles | Never public | Operational trace data; access itself must be logged.
AuditLog | actor_account_id; actor_role; scope_decision; entity_id | Highly Restricted | Security Reviewer and least-privileged authorised roles | Never public | Can identify user activity and protected object access.
AuditLog | before_summary; after_summary; reason; operational_error_summary | Highly Restricted | Security Reviewer and strictly scoped reviewers | Never public | May contain sensitive context; redact values and never log credentials or tokens.

Imports files and diagnostics
Entity | Field | Class | Default visibility | Public projection rule | Classification rationale
ImportJob | job_id; template_version; row_counts; created_at; state | Internal | Data Steward; System Administrator; Security Reviewer | Never public | Operational processing data.
ImportJob | submitted_by_account_id; original_filename; storage_key; checksum | Highly Restricted | Data Steward; System Administrator; Security Reviewer | Never public | Can identify actor or expose file correlation; binary stays in private object storage.
ImportRowError | row_number; error_code; field_name | Restricted | Data Steward within job scope | Never public | Diagnostic data should expose only structured error codes.
ImportRowError | rejected_value; error_detail | Highly Restricted | Data Steward within job scope; Security Reviewer | Never public | May contain accidental sensitive input; redact and quarantine where indicated.
FileScanEvent | mime_type; size; scanner_result; quarantine_state | Restricted | System Administrator; Security Reviewer | Never public | Security control metadata.
FileScanEvent | storage_key; object_checksum; scanner_detail | Highly Restricted | System Administrator; Security Reviewer | Never public | Operational security correlation data.

2 Public Projection Design
Proposal — public projection is a dedicated read model, not a filtered view of private tables. It is generated only from allow-listed fields and never joins to audit, applications, access assignments, imports, person references, or free-text rationale.
Projection field | Source field | Class | Release rule
public_entry_id | Derived opaque projection ID | Public | Use a projection-specific identifier; do not reuse internal IDs.
organisation_label | Organisation.display_name | Public | Only after Owner confirms disclosure intent and DPO or legal reviewer clears publication path.
role_label | LeadershipAppointment.role_taxonomy_code resolved to label | Public | Only approved taxonomy labels; no person reference or unreviewed hierarchy.
term_label | Derived from approved term rule | Public | Only when the owner explicitly approves display of a term; omit granular dates by default.
publication_state | Derived release control | Internal | Never returned to public callers; gates record generation and cache release.

Confirmed public-API guardrail | Required behaviour
Allow-list serializer | Public route creates response solely from the projection schema with unknown-field rejection; private table objects are never serialised directly.
No protected joins | Public route cannot join synthetic_person_ref, application, access, audit, import, file, status-event reason, or raw hierarchy-key fields.
Server release gate | Public route verifies publication approval state on the server. Absence of an approval record returns no entry, not a partially filtered entry.
Cache control | Proposal — cache only projection output after approval; purge projection/cache on withdrawal. Do not cache restricted API responses in a shared layer.

3 Field Visibility and Data Minimisation
Audience or role | May view | Must not view | Enforcement
Unauthenticated public caller | Only reviewed Public projection fields. | All Internal, Restricted, Highly Restricted fields, and unpublished projection records. | Dedicated server route, allow-list schema, release gate, non-enumerating response.
Applicant self-service synthetic session | Its own synthetic application state and minimal selection fields. | Other applicants, audit history, reviewer identity, role/scope data, file diagnostics. | Server scope binds account to synthetic applicant reference.
Directory or exam operations role | Restricted records within assigned scope. | Highly Restricted fields except minimum fields for approved task; all external scope records. | requirePermission plus buildScopeWhere before query and mutation.
Data Steward | Synthetic master data and import diagnostics for assigned job. | Raw rejected values unless necessary and separately authorised; unrelated audit data. | Job and organisation scope; redaction policy.
Security Reviewer | Audit and security metadata under explicit purpose. | Business data beyond required redacted summary; file content without separate authorisation. | Dedicated audit permission, time-bounded scope, access logging.
System Administrator | Identity/access and operational controls under explicit task. | Business workflow content unless separately scoped. | Separation of duties and server-side role policy.

Data minimisation control | Status | Design requirement
Synthetic identity references only | Confirmed | Use opaque synthetic references, not names, contact details, government identifiers, images, or documents.
Structured reasons before free text | Proposal | Use configured reason codes. Optional notes are disabled by default, length-limited when approved, and classified Highly Restricted.
No binary content in database | Confirmed | Store approved files in private object storage; PostgreSQL holds minimal metadata and storage key only.
Exports | Proposal | Generate scoped, purpose-specific exports with class-based column allow list. Public export uses public projection only.
Analytics | Proposal | Use aggregate synthetic counts where possible; prohibit joins that reconstruct applicant or person-reference histories.

4 Retention and History
No retention period is set in this document. Exact periods, archival, deletion, legal holds, and any transition to real data require owner and DPO or legal review. Append-only history means normal operations never overwrite historical events; it does not itself decide retention duration.
Data set | Proposed operational treatment | Review gate
Synthetic business records | Retain only for the approved test or review window. Privileged synthetic-data purge creates a purge event and preserves no business history beyond the configured environment policy. | Owner confirms test-window lifecycle.
Audit and status history | Keep append-only while retained; access is Highly Restricted. Archive or disposal cannot modify old events. | DPO/legal plus Security Reviewer define retention and archival treatment.
Import files and rejected values | Keep private only long enough to diagnose the import job; quarantine suspected real data and block further processing. | DPO/legal review for any suspected real data; Owner defines synthetic diagnostic window.
Public projection cache | Invalidate on withdrawal, reclassification, status uncertainty, or release-gate change. | Owner and DPO/legal reviewer approve public release and withdrawal handling.

5 Access Logging and Audit
Event | Minimum metadata | Class | Prohibited log content
Protected read or export | Actor account ID, role, scope decision, entity type, request ID, timestamp, outcome. | Highly Restricted | Passwords, tokens, raw file content, protected free text, or full before/after payloads.
Mutation or status change | Actor, role, scope decision, entity ID, action, reason code, request ID, linked history event. | Highly Restricted | Credentials and unnecessary sensitive field values.
Public projection read | Route/version, projection ID, timestamp, response outcome, request correlation ID. | Internal | Client identity data unless separately approved; no protected source IDs.
Denied access or suspicious import | Actor if authenticated, requested resource class, reason category, request ID, quarantine reference if applicable. | Highly Restricted | Raw unauthorised payload or suspected real content.

Confirmed — audit records are append-only. Proposal — privileged audit-read events are logged and reviewed through a purpose-limited access process.
6 Failure Modes and Recovery
Failure mode | Detection and containment | Recovery | Status
Public API serialises a restricted field | Schema allow-list and response contract detect non-projection field. | Disable route/cache, revoke release state, roll forward corrected projection, inspect access logs, notify governance owner for assessment. | Proposal
Scope filter missing or fails | Server policy fails closed; tests require deny result. | Return safe deny/unavailable response, stop export/mutation, repair policy, record incident event; do not infer records. | Confirmed
Audit write fails | Transaction cannot complete business write plus audit/history atomically. | Roll back related mutation, preserve no partial change, investigate and retry safely. | Confirmed
Suspected real data in import or file | Synthetic marker, validation, scanner, or reviewer flags input. | Stop processing, quarantine private object/job, restrict access, notify Owner and DPO/legal reviewer; do not certify outcome. | Needs Legal Review
Retention job targets wrong synthetic data | Purge workflow validates environment and approval marker before execution. | Stop job, preserve purge log, restore only from approved backup if available, investigate configuration. | Proposal

7 DPO and Legal Review Register
Topic | Why review is required | Owner | Status
Public directory or public API release | Determines whether any Public candidate projection may be disclosed and what approval/notice is required. | DPO and legal reviewer; Product Owner | Needs Legal Review
Real personal data or real organisational status | Changes the synthetic-only boundary and may introduce legal/official representation concerns. | DPO and legal reviewer; Authorised Business Owner | Needs Legal Review
Retention archival deletion and backup recovery | Defines duration, holds, access, and disposal treatment; this design intentionally sets no legal period. | DPO/legal; Security Reviewer; Product Owner | Needs Legal Review
Free text attachments or supporting documents | Can introduce unbounded sensitive content; current design prohibits it by default. | DPO/legal; Product Owner | Needs Legal Review
Processor storage location and incident process | Requires organisational decision about approved providers, access, and response process. | DPO/legal; Security Reviewer | Needs Legal Review

This register identifies review points only. It does not provide legal advice, determine legal obligations, or certify compliance.
8 Public API Privacy Test Plan
The following are planned tests only. They are not execution results.
Test ID | Scenario | Expected privacy result | Evidence when executed
PAPI-01 | Anonymous GET on approved public projection route. | Response contains only allow-listed projection fields and no internal source identifiers. | Captured response-schema assertion and route test result.
PAPI-02 | Attempt to request person, applicant, audit, reason, raw status-event, access, import, or file field. | Field is absent; unknown-field query does not expand response. | Negative response-field assertion.
PAPI-03 | Request unpublished or withdrawn projection ID. | Non-enumerating not-found or safe response; no data existence inference. | Route test with release-gate fixture.
PAPI-04 | Attempt direct API/object reference to restricted entity ID through public route. | Denied or safe not-found response; no restricted fields or relationship keys. | Authorisation and scope test evidence.
PAPI-05 | Review shared-cache behaviour after withdrawal/reclassification. | Projection cache purged or bypassed; restricted response is never shared-cached. | Cache-control and invalidation evidence.
PAPI-06 | Inspect public route logs. | Logs contain no protected source IDs, person/application references, free text, credentials, or tokens. | Structured-log assertion and redaction review.

9 Coverage Review and Owner Checklist
Coverage item | Result | Interpretation
Entity-domain groups classified | 6 of 6 | Every proposed entity-domain group used by current requirements has a field catalogue entry.
Field groups classified | 42 of 42 | Every enumerated proposed logical field group has class, default visibility, public-projection rule, and rationale.
Public route safeguards | 6 planned tests | Public API privacy tests cover field allow list, absence of restricted fields, release gate, object access, cache, and log redaction.
Executed public API privacy tests | 0 | No API implementation or test result is claimed by this document.

☐ Confirm the logical field catalogue and classifications before schema implementation.
☐ Approve or revise the synthetic test-data lifecycle and purge workflow.
☐ Approve the public projection as a dedicated model, not a filtered private-table response.
☐ Assign DPO/legal reviewers for every item in the review register.
☐ Assign owner and evidence location for PAPI-01 through PAPI-06 before public-route implementation.
Verification Note
Coverage was checked for document completeness only. No public API privacy test, database migration, object-storage control, access policy, retention job, or incident workflow has been executed or certified.

documents.text:
Detailed Requirements
Sangha and Education Data Platform
Item | Details
Purpose | Functional requirements and traceability baseline for coverage review.
Document status | Proposal — detailed design baseline for owner review.
Data boundary | Confirmed — synthetic, fictional, non-identifying data only.
Architecture alignment | Confirmed — Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Auth.js, server actions and protected API routes; no conflicting components.
Verification method | Coverage of Requirement to UI to API to Table to Test mapping; this document reports design coverage only, not product test results.

This document elaborates the functions approved in the Project Charter. “Table” identifies a proposed logical data table, not a completed database migration. “Test” identifies a planned test case, not a test that has been run.
Status Labels
Label | Meaning
Confirmed | Requirement or constraint established by the work request, Project Charter, or approved architecture.
Proposal | Detailed behaviour, schema, workflow, metric, or test design that requires owner confirmation.
Needs Legal Review | Real-data use, disclosure, retention, or official-status issue outside this synthetic-data scope.

Requirement Conventions
Convention | Application
Authorization | Every protected action invokes server-side authorization and scope filtering. Client roles, URL values, and UI visibility do not grant permission.
History | Every correction creates a new event or version. Business history and audit events are never overwritten by normal operations.
Failure recovery | A business write and its history/audit record commit atomically or roll back together. Corrective actions append new evidence.
Synthetic-only control | All inputs must be marked synthetic. A suspected real-data import is stopped, quarantined, and escalated; it is not processed.
Coverage | Each functional requirement receives one traceability row with UI, API/service, proposed table(s), and planned tests.

1 Detailed Functional Requirements
FR-ORG-01 Maintain synthetic organisation
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Education Directory Manager; Data Steward.
Input | Synthetic organisation code, display name, type, parent organisation, and lifecycle reason.
Process | Authorise on the server, validate the parent relationship, create the organisation version, then append an AuditLog event.
Output | New synthetic organisation record with current lifecycle state and immutable history reference.
Permission | Server policy requires organisation.create within the actor scope; deny by default.
Validation | Code is unique; name is required; parent cannot create a cycle; record is marked synthetic.
Error state and recovery | Duplicate code or invalid parent: no commit; return field error. Transaction failure: roll back business record and audit event; retry with idempotency key.
Acceptance criteria | Authorised actor can create one valid synthetic organisation; unauthorised actor receives deny response and no data or audit mutation occurs.
Audit | Actor ID, role, request ID, timestamp, action=ORGANISATION_CREATED, input summary, resulting record ID, reason.

FR-ORG-02 Change organisation lifecycle status
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Education Directory Manager; Product Owner for configured approval cases.
Input | Organisation ID, requested status, reason, optional effective date.
Process | Authorise, confirm the organisation is synthetic, create an OrganisationStatusEvent, update the current projection in the same transaction, then append AuditLog.
Output | Current status projection and linked, append-only status event.
Permission | Server policy requires organisation.status.change within scope; client status values are never trusted.
Validation | Status must exist in owner-approved master data; reason required; effective date cannot precede the record creation date.
Error state and recovery | Unknown status or missing reason: reject without write. Incorrect completed change: create corrective status event; never alter the old event.
Acceptance criteria | A valid change exposes current status and prior status event; a corrective change leaves both historical events readable.
Audit | Actor, prior status, requested status, reason, effective date, request ID, status-event ID.

FR-DIR-01 Maintain education leadership appointment
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Education Directory Manager.
Input | Synthetic person reference, role taxonomy code, organisation, start date, optional end date, appointment reason.
Process | Authorise, validate role taxonomy and dates, create a LeadershipAppointment version, and append AuditLog.
Output | Synthetic appointment in the directory, linked to its organisation and term.
Permission | Server policy requires directory.appointment.write and scope access to the organisation.
Validation | Only synthetic person references; required role and organisation; end date is not before start date; overlapping appointments follow owner-approved rule.
Error state and recovery | Out-of-scope actor or invalid date: no write. Overlap conflict: return conflict details without exposing data outside scope.
Acceptance criteria | Authorised actor creates valid appointment and can view its history; external-scope actor cannot read or create it.
Audit | Actor, role, organisation, synthetic person reference, term values, reason, request ID.

FR-SEC-01 Maintain secretary assignment
Proposal — Overall requirement status: Proposal
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Education Directory Manager.
Input | Synthetic secretary reference, target role or organisation, effective start/end dates, reason.
Process | Authorise, validate one permitted target relationship, create SecretaryAssignment, and append AuditLog.
Output | Current assignment and assignment history.
Permission | Server policy requires directory.secretary.write and target scope.
Validation | Exactly one target type is required unless Owner approves dual-link behaviour; dates must be valid; synthetic reference only.
Error state and recovery | Missing or ambiguous target: reject. Correction: add superseding assignment or corrective event; do not overwrite original assignment.
Acceptance criteria | Valid assignment is searchable by target; invalid dual-link rule is rejected until Owner confirms it.
Audit | Actor, synthetic secretary reference, target type and ID, dates, reason, request ID.

FR-INS-01 Maintain institution leadership
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Education Directory Manager.
Input | Synthetic institution ID, synthetic head or principal reference, position label, term dates, reason.
Process | Authorise, verify organisation type is eligible in configured master data, create InstitutionLeadershipAssignment, append AuditLog.
Output | Current institution leadership projection and term history.
Permission | Server policy requires institution.leadership.write within organisation scope.
Validation | Institution must be synthetic; position label is a configured neutral prototype term; dates are chronological.
Error state and recovery | Ineligible organisation or invalid term: reject without commit. Transaction fault: roll back and retry safely.
Acceptance criteria | Authorised actor can record and correct a synthetic assignment without losing earlier history.
Audit | Actor, institution ID, synthetic head reference, role label, dates, reason, request ID.

FR-CENT-01 Maintain synthetic exam centre
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Exam Operations Officer; Data Steward.
Input | Synthetic centre code, name, linked organisation, stated capacity, status, reason.
Process | Authorise, validate code and capacity, create ExamCentre plus initial status event atomically, append AuditLog.
Output | Synthetic exam-centre record with current status and event history.
Permission | Server policy requires examcentre.write within configured scope.
Validation | Code unique; capacity is non-negative integer; linked organisation exists and is synthetic; status is configured.
Error state and recovery | Duplicate code, invalid capacity, or missing parent: reject. Wrong status: create corrective event; never rewrite prior event.
Acceptance criteria | Valid centre can be created with traceable status. A denied request leaves no centre or status event.
Audit | Actor, centre code, organisation ID, capacity, status, reason, request ID.

FR-APP-01 Create synthetic learner exam application
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Applicant Services Officer acting in synthetic test workflow; synthetic Applicant Portal session.
Input | Synthetic applicant reference, programme or exam selection, selected synthetic centre, declaration flag.
Process | Authorise on server, validate synthetic marker and referenced records, create Application in draft or submitted state, append ApplicationStatusEvent and AuditLog.
Output | Synthetic application identifier, current status, and status history.
Permission | Server policy requires application.create; self-service scope may only act on its own synthetic applicant reference.
Validation | All references are synthetic; required selection exists; selected centre is active in configured mock data; no duplicate active application under configured rule.
Error state and recovery | Invalid reference or duplicate: no commit and show safe field error. Service interruption: roll back both application and status event; allow idempotent retry.
Acceptance criteria | Authorised workflow creates one traceable synthetic application. Real-data marker or unauthorised request is denied with no mutation.
Audit | Actor, synthetic applicant reference, programme/exam reference, centre ID, status, request ID; no real personal data.

FR-APP-02 Review synthetic application and change status
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Exam Operations Officer; authorised Product Owner reviewer.
Input | Application ID, requested status, review reason, optional reviewer note.
Process | Authorise, load application through scope filter, validate transition against configured lifecycle, create ApplicationStatusEvent, update current projection atomically, append AuditLog.
Output | New current status plus immutable chronological status history.
Permission | Server policy requires application.review and application.status.change within scope.
Validation | Transition must be configured; reason is mandatory; requester cannot approve if separation-of-duty rule is enabled by Owner.
Error state and recovery | Invalid transition or missing reason: reject. Incorrect decision: append corrective event; do not overwrite older status or audit data.
Acceptance criteria | Allowed transition produces one event; denied transition produces none. History shows prior and corrective states in order.
Audit | Actor, prior/new state, decision reason, optional note classification, request ID, status-event ID.

FR-IMP-01 Import synthetic data
Proposal — Overall requirement status: Proposal
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Data Steward; System Administrator for operational recovery only.
Input | Approved import template containing synthetic rows and explicit synthetic-data marker.
Process | Create ImportJob only through authorised server endpoint; parse in protected service; validate all rows; commit approved records and audit events transactionally or retain error report with no partial business commit.
Output | ImportJob status, accepted-row count, rejected-row details, linked created record IDs when committed.
Permission | Server policy requires import.create; file storage is private and metadata only is stored in database.
Validation | Marker required; file size/type rules configured by Owner; duplicate codes, invalid references, and non-synthetic markers fail validation.
Error state and recovery | Row validation failure: record ImportRowError and do not commit invalid rows. Wrong real-data import: stop, quarantine file and job, notify Owner, await legal/compliance direction.
Acceptance criteria | Valid all-synthetic import produces a completed job and audit evidence. Invalid template produces error report without partial commit unless Owner approves a documented partial-import rule.
Audit | Actor, file metadata only, template version, job ID, row counts, validation summary, request ID.

FR-AUD-01 View append only history
Confirmed — Overall requirement status: Confirmed
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | Product Owner, Security Reviewer, System Administrator, scoped data manager.
Input | Entity type, entity ID, optional date range.
Process | Authorise on server, apply scope filter, query immutable AuditLog and entity event history, return ordered records with redaction policy applied.
Output | Chronological history showing actor role, timestamp, action, reason, before/after summary, and request ID where permitted.
Permission | Server policy requires audit.read; scope filter is mandatory. No client-provided role or scope may grant access.
Validation | Entity type is allow-listed; date range bounded; audit record is never editable through this function.
Error state and recovery | Out-of-scope or forbidden: return non-enumerating deny response. Query failure: log operational error without sensitive payload and retry after service recovery.
Acceptance criteria | Authorised reviewer sees a correction as a new event; user without scope cannot infer that another record exists.
Audit | Audit-read event captures actor, query type, entity type, scope decision, request ID; does not mutate viewed history.

FR-ACC-01 Manage access roles and scope assignments
Proposal — Overall requirement status: Proposal
Field | Detailed requirement
Actor | System Administrator; Product Owner approval for policy changes.
Input | User account identifier, role code, scope reference, effective dates, change reason.
Process | Authorise at highest administrative policy, validate configured role and scope, create RoleAssignment version, invalidate affected sessions as configured, append AuditLog.
Output | Current access assignment and immutable access-change history.
Permission | Server policy requires access.manage and explicit administrative scope; roles are resolved on server for each sensitive operation.
Validation | Role and scope must be configured; no self-escalation; effective dates valid; no role data accepted from client as authority.
Error state and recovery | Invalid role, scope, or self-escalation: reject. Accidental change: create corrective assignment and revoke affected session; preserve prior event.
Acceptance criteria | New role assignment affects an authorised server request only after policy reload. Client-only role manipulation cannot elevate access.
Audit | Actor, affected account ID, old/new role and scope, reason, effective dates, session invalidation outcome, request ID.

2 Cross Cutting Failure Modes and Recovery
Failure mode | Detection and containment | Recovery | Status
Server authorization dependency unavailable | Protected operation fails closed; no privileged fallback to client state. | Return safe unavailable response, preserve no partial write, alert operator, restore service, then retry with request idempotency. | Confirmed
Audit or history write cannot be completed | Transaction boundary detects failure before commit. | Roll back related business mutation; inspect error; retry after service recovery. | Confirmed
Incorrect approved status change | Audit trail and status event show conflict. | Append corrective status event and reason; never edit old event. | Confirmed
Synthetic import may contain real data | Synthetic-data marker check, isolation, and import validation flag condition. | Stop job, quarantine file/job metadata, notify owner; await legal/compliance direction. | Needs Legal Review
Role scope changes during session | Sensitive server action reloads policy and scope source. | Invalidate affected session if configured; reauthorise next action and inspect audit history. | Proposal

3 Traceability Requirement UI API Table Test

FR-SEC-01 | Admin Directory Secretaries | server/actions/secretary.assign | SecretaryAssignment; AuditLog | TC-SEC-01 target rule; TC-SEC-02 correction

FR-APP-01 | Portal Application Create | server/actions/application.create | Application; ApplicationStatusEvent; AuditLog | TC-APP-01 submit; TC-APP-02 duplicate; TC-APP-03 real marker deny
FR-APP-02 | Admin Applications Review | server/actions/application.changeStatus | ApplicationStatusEvent; AuditLog | TC-APP-04 transition; TC-APP-05 corrective event
FR-IMP-01 | Admin Imports New Job | POST /api/imports; server/services/import | ImportJob; ImportRowError; AuditLog | TC-IMP-01 valid; TC-IMP-02 row error; TC-IMP-03 quarantine
FR-AUD-01 | Admin Audit History | server/actions/audit.list | AuditLog; entity event tables | TC-AUD-01 scope allow; TC-AUD-02 non-enumerating deny

4 Coverage Review

documents.text:
Legal Mapping Register
Sangha and Education Data Platform
Item | Details
Purpose | A review-ready register for the supplied abbreviation, positions, approval authority, documents and statuses. It preserves source and reviewer traceability without inferring any law or official rule.
Scope | Synthetic, fictional and non-identifying data only. The register is a design and evidence-management artifact, not a legal conclusion.
Main conclusion | Every legal source, section and effective date is TO VERIFY until an authorised reviewer records evidence. No production/public/legal-release decision may be inferred from this document.
Architecture alignment | Confirmed: protected Next.js routes/server actions, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Auth.js, server-side authorisation and scope filtering, private object storage, append-only history and audit.
Verification method | Evidence or TO VERIFY. This document includes a completeness check only; it does not claim a legal review, compliance assessment or product test.

Status Labels
Label | Meaning
Confirmed | Technical or project constraint already established by the approved architecture or prior requirements. It is not legal evidence.
Proposal | A register structure or control pattern needing owner confirmation before implementation.
Needs Legal Review | A source, legal interpretation, approval power, public release, document rule, retention or official-status decision requiring authorised review.
TO VERIFY | No source title, section or effective-date evidence has been provided. The field must remain visibly unresolved; it must not be filled by assumption.
The supplied abbreviation is retained as an unresolved business term. Its expansion, source and applicability are not inferred.
1 Evidence Rules and Required Register Fields
Each mapping record links an operational topic to its evidence. A reviewer may mark evidence Verified only after recording the source title, section or official identifier, effective dates, review outcome and evidence location. Until then, the record remains TO VERIFY and Needs Legal Review.
Record field | Required handling | Status
source_title | Exact supplied title of the instrument, order, guidance or authoritative record. Do not fabricate a title. | Proposal
section_reference | Exact section, clause, page, paragraph or identifier from the supplied source; otherwise TO VERIFY. | Proposal
effective_from and effective_to | Record dates only from supplied evidence. Use unknown/TO VERIFY, not an assumed date. | Proposal
reviewer_role and review_outcome | Use role-based reviewers. Do not insert real individuals in the synthetic environment. | Confirmed
evidence_reference | Store immutable document reference, hash/version or repository location; retain reviewed version. | Proposal
mapping_status | Use Confirmed, Proposal or Needs Legal Review. Keep historical status events append-only. | Confirmed

2 Legal Mapping Master Register
All source evidence is intentionally marked TO VERIFY because no legal source material was supplied. This register makes the missing evidence explicit and assigns role-based review ownership.
ID | Topic or controlled object | Decision and record required | Required evidence fields | Reviewer role | Evidence and legal status
LM-01 | Supplied abbreviation applicability | Record the owner-approved expansion, scope and applicability of the supplied abbreviation. No meaning is inferred. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-02 | Position taxonomy and hierarchy | Approve the allowed position types, hierarchy relationships, education-side designations and whether each is displayable. Retain change history. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-03 | Appointment or assignment record | Define evidence required to create, amend, end or correct a position assignment; store a document reference and decision event, not an overwrite. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Approver; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-04 | Secretary and institution leadership | Define which appointment, delegation or term evidence supports a secretary, head or principal record and the applicable scope. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Approver; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-05 | Acting, delegation and term validity | Define acting authority, delegator, permitted action set, effective start/end, revocation and conflict handling. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Approver; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-06 | Approval authority matrix | Map each approval action to an authorised role, scope, required source and required evidence. Server policy must deny when no current mapping exists. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-07 | Organisation and unit status | Define permitted status values, status-transition authority, evidence, effective dates and whether status may be represented as official. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Authorised Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-08 | Education organisation record | Define authority, source document and lifecycle evidence for each education organisation and related leadership assignment. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Education Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-09 | Exam centre and exam status | Define designation, operation, suspension and closure decisions, approver scope and supporting documents. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Exam Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-10 | Learner and exam application decisions | Define who may verify, approve, reject or correct a synthetic application and the required evidence/status history. No real-data rule is assumed. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Application Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-11 | Supporting documents and attachments | Define document categories, permitted content, retention, reviewers, reference format and any rule for image/file processing. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | DPO; Legal Reviewer; Owner | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-12 | Public directory and public API release | Define if any role, organisation, status or term is eligible for disclosure, who approves release, and the withdrawal path. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | DPO; Legal Reviewer; Product Owner | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-13 | Retention, archive, deletion and backups | Define retention periods, legal holds, archival, deletion approval, recovery limits and evidence required for disposal. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | DPO; Legal Reviewer; Security Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-14 | Imports, exports and correction records | Define permitted import/export authority, document/evidence handling, correction process and data-quality sign-off. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Data Owner; Legal Reviewer | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review
LM-15 | Source conflict or expiry | Define precedence and escalation when sources conflict, a source is revoked/expired, or evidence is incomplete. Do not choose automatically. | Source title: TO VERIFYSection: TO VERIFYEffective dates: TO VERIFY | Legal Reviewer; Authorised Owner | TO VERIFYNeeds Legal Review

3 Proposed Logical Records
Proposal: implement these as logical records in the approved database. These names are design identifiers, not a claim that a legal system prescribes a particular schema.
Logical record | Minimum fields | History and control
LegalSource | source_id, source_title, issuer_ref, source_type, section_reference, effective_from, effective_to, evidence_reference, evidence_status | New version creates a source-version record. A superseded source remains queryable with its validity range.
LegalMappingRegister | mapping_id, topic, controlled_object, required_decision, source_id, reviewer_role, review_outcome, evidence_status, mapping_status | Each review creates a new review event; do not overwrite prior reviewer outcome or source linkage.
PositionAuthorityRule | rule_id, position_type, action_code, scope_rule, delegation_allowed, source_id, effective dates, status | Server policy reads only current, verified and in-scope rules after legal/owner approval.
ApprovalDecisionEvent | decision_id, action_code, target_ref, approver_role, scope_decision, source_ref, evidence_ref, timestamp, outcome | Append-only. Business status and audit/history event commit atomically or roll back together.
DocumentEvidenceReference | document_ref, category, owner_scope, source_version_ref, integrity_ref, received_at, review_state | Private object storage; database holds minimal reference metadata. No public response includes protected document fields.
StatusEvent | event_id, entity_type, entity_ref, prior_status, new_status, effective_at, reason_code, decision_ref | Append-only status history; a correction creates a later event linked to the earlier one.
4 Authority Document and Status Flow
Step | Required server behaviour | Mapping state
1. Resolve action | Identify the action, target type, requested scope and current position/authority rule. | Confirmed technical control
2. Require evidence | If source, section, effective date or review approval is TO VERIFY, prevent an action that needs legal authority; return a safe pending-review result. | Proposal
3. Verify authority | Server applies deny-by-default role and scope policy. UI controls, client claims and request parameters do not grant authority. | Confirmed
4. Record decision | Write decision, evidence reference, status event and audit event atomically. Preserve earlier records. | Confirmed
5. Publish only after gate | Public projection excludes authority, document, applicant, audit and raw status-history fields. Publication eligibility remains Needs Legal Review. | Needs Legal Review
5 Failure Modes and Recovery
Failure mode | Detection and containment | Recovery | Status
Source absent or incomplete | Evidence field is TO VERIFY; prevent it from being treated as verified authority. | Keep record pending, request source from owner/legal reviewer, then append a review event. | Needs Legal Review
Conflicting or expired source | Effective-date validation or reviewer flags a conflict. | Stop automatic decision; preserve both source versions and obtain an authorised resolution event. | Needs Legal Review
Authority rule missing or out of scope | Server policy cannot resolve a verified rule for action and target scope. | Deny safely, write a non-sensitive audit event, route to owner/legal review. | Confirmed
Document reference unavailable or integrity check fails | Private-store lookup or integrity/reference check fails. | Quarantine/withhold decision, retain failure event, restore only from approved copy where available. | Proposal
Audit/history write fails | Atomic transaction cannot complete. | Roll back related mutation; do not leave a partial approval or overwrite historical record. | Confirmed
6 Evidence and TO VERIFY Review Checklist
Check | Pass condition | Current result
Source coverage | Every mapping row contains source title, section/identifier and effective-date fields, each evidenced or marked TO VERIFY. | TO VERIFY recorded for 15 of 15 rows
Role coverage | Every mapping row assigns a role-based reviewer; no real person is assumed. | Present for 15 of 15 rows
Status coverage | Every mapping row carries evidence state and legal-review status. | Present for 15 of 15 rows
Operational guardrails | Approval and status changes require server-side authorisation and append-only decision/audit history. | Confirmed design constraint
Owner action | Owner supplies source evidence and assigns authorised legal/DPO reviewers before a rule becomes Verified. | Open
Verification note: the executed check validates register completeness only. No legal evidence review, legal interpretation, public API test, migration, authorisation policy or workflow test has been executed or certified.

documents.text:
PostgreSQL Entity Relationship Design
Sangha and Education Data Platform
Item | Details
Purpose | Normalised logical PostgreSQL design for identity, roles, scopes, people, contacts, organisations, positions, legal evidence, exams, candidates, applications, documents, imports and audit.
Core decision | Person and position are separate. Each business status is represented by an append-only event. The current state is derived from the latest valid event rather than overwriting history.
Architecture alignment | Confirmed: Prisma/PostgreSQL, protected server actions/API routes, Auth.js, server-side role-and-scope authorisation, private object storage, and atomic business/history/audit transactions.
Boundary | Synthetic, fictional, non-identifying data only. This logical ERD neither creates legal authority nor approves real-data processing, public disclosure or retention periods.
Verification method | Normalisation and history design review. No migration, database constraint, query plan, policy or product test is claimed as executed.
Status Labels
Label | Meaning
Confirmed | Established architecture or history/security constraint; not a release or legal decision.
Proposal | Logical tables, fields, indexes and workflow constraints to confirm before migration.
Needs Legal Review | Retention, official status, real-data use, public release, source authority and document policy requiring review.

1 Core Entity Relationship Diagram
Arrow labels show parent-to-child cardinality. Relationship tables use explicit foreign keys; audit_event and approval_decision_event are documented controlled-reference exceptions because they can point to several entity classes.

Confirmed: no position, organisation role or contact information is stored on person as a duplicate. A position assignment joins a person to a position and organisation for an effective period.
2 Workflow and Governance Relationships
The workflow domain connects candidates, sessions and centres through application. Documents are anchored in private object metadata then linked through explicit application, legal-source or approval association tables.

Proposal: legal mapping, evidence review and publication/approval decisions remain separate from operational workflow data. A legal reviewer role has no implied operating-data access.
3 Access and Identity Tables
Table | Primary key | Foreign keys | Normalised purpose and constraints | Class | Status
app_user | user_id UUID | person_id -> person nullable | Auth subject and synthetic marker; unique auth_provider + subject. | Internal | Confirmed
app_role | role_id UUID | none | Stable role_code unique; role meaning is configuration. | Internal | Proposal
access_scope | scope_id UUID | organisation_id -> organisation nullable | Scope type and organisation boundary; unique scope_type + organisation_id. | Internal | Proposal
user_role_scope_grant | grant_id UUID | user_id -> app_user; role_id -> app_role; scope_id -> access_scope | Effective range; grant never overwritten; revocation is event. | Restricted | Proposal
user_role_scope_event | event_id UUID | grant_id -> user_role_scope_grant; actor_user_id -> app_user | GRANTED/REVOKED/CORRECTED event; append-only. | Highly Restricted | Confirmed
person | person_id UUID | none | Synthetic minimal identity reference only; no position or contact fields. | Restricted | Proposal
person_private | person_id UUID | person_id -> person | One-to-one sensitive attributes; separated from operational directory rows. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
person_contact | contact_id UUID | person_id -> person | Contact channel/type/value protected separately; default never public. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
4 Organisation Position and History Tables
Table | Primary key | Foreign keys | Normalised purpose and constraints | Class | Status
organisation | organisation_id UUID | parent_organisation_id -> organisation nullable | Adjacency hierarchy; org_code unique; display name internal/restricted. | Restricted | Proposal
organisation_status_event | event_id UUID | organisation_id -> organisation; decision_id -> approval_decision_event nullable | Status transition event with effective_at; append-only. | Restricted | Confirmed
position_catalog | position_id UUID | none | Position taxonomy only; position_code unique; no person data. | Restricted | Proposal
position_assignment | assignment_id UUID | position_id -> position_catalog; organisation_id -> organisation; person_id -> person nullable | Separates position from person. Effective range; one current assignment constraint proposed. | Restricted | Proposal
position_assignment_status_event | event_id UUID | assignment_id -> position_assignment; decision_id -> approval_decision_event nullable | Appointment/correction/term event; append-only. | Highly Restricted | Confirmed
secretary_assignment | assignment_id UUID | organisation_id -> organisation; person_id -> person; related_position_assignment_id nullable | Separate secretary relationship and dates; no role fields copied to person. | Restricted | Proposal
5 Legal Evidence and Approval Tables
Table | Primary key | Foreign keys | Normalised purpose and constraints | Class | Status
legal_source | source_id UUID | none | Supplied source title/issuer only; no inferred law names or sections. | Restricted | Proposal
legal_source_version | source_version_id UUID | source_id -> legal_source | Section reference, effective dates, evidence ref, verification state. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
legal_mapping | mapping_id UUID | source_version_id -> legal_source_version nullable | Topic/control mapping; absent source remains TO VERIFY. | Restricted | Proposal
legal_review_event | event_id UUID | mapping_id -> legal_mapping; reviewer_user_id -> app_user nullable | Role-based outcome, evidence reference and timestamp; append-only. | Highly Restricted | Confirmed
approval_decision_event | decision_id UUID | actor_user_id -> app_user; source_version_id -> legal_source_version nullable | Cross-domain approval evidence; target_type/id is controlled reference. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
6 Exam Candidate Document Import and Audit Tables
Table | Primary key | Foreign keys | Normalised purpose and constraints | Class | Status
exam_program | program_id UUID | none | Synthetic program taxonomy; program_code unique. | Restricted | Proposal
exam_session | session_id UUID | program_id -> exam_program | Session lifecycle and dates; not a public result record. | Restricted | Proposal
exam_centre | centre_id UUID | organisation_id -> organisation nullable | Centre identity and scope; centre_code unique. | Restricted | Proposal
exam_centre_status_event | event_id UUID | centre_id -> exam_centre; decision_id -> approval_decision_event nullable | Lifecycle transition event; append-only. | Restricted | Confirmed
candidate | candidate_id UUID | person_id -> person nullable | Synthetic candidate reference; person fields not duplicated. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
candidate_private | candidate_id UUID | candidate_id -> candidate | Sensitive eligibility/declaration fields separated one-to-one. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
application | application_id UUID | candidate_id -> candidate; session_id -> exam_session; centre_id -> exam_centre nullable | Unique candidate + session; immutable submitted snapshot fields only where necessary. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
application_status_event | event_id UUID | application_id -> application; decision_id -> approval_decision_event nullable | DRAFT/SUBMITTED/etc event; append-only, no update of prior decision. | Highly Restricted | Confirmed
document_record | document_id UUID | none | Private object metadata, storage key and integrity reference; binary not in PostgreSQL. | Highly Restricted | Confirmed
application_document_link | link_id UUID | application_id -> application; document_id -> document_record | Explicit FK attachment link; category/received state; no polymorphic owner field. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
legal_source_document_link | link_id UUID | source_version_id -> legal_source_version; document_id -> document_record | Evidence document link with explicit FK. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
approval_document_link | link_id UUID | decision_id -> approval_decision_event; document_id -> document_record | Approval evidence link with explicit FK. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
import_job | job_id UUID | submitted_by_user_id -> app_user | Private synthetic import processing job; template version and counts. | Internal | Proposal
import_row_error | error_id UUID | job_id -> import_job | Structured error code/field; raw rejected values stored separately/redacted. | Restricted | Proposal
import_error_detail | detail_id UUID | error_id -> import_row_error | Highly restricted rejected value/detail; shortest diagnostic retention. | Highly Restricted | Proposal
audit_event | audit_id UUID | actor_user_id -> app_user nullable | Append-only access/mutation audit; entity_type/entity_id controlled reference exception. | Highly Restricted | Confirmed
7 Key Constraints and Indexes
Area | Unique and primary-key rules | Foreign-key and check rules | Recommended indexes | Status
Identity and access | UUID PKs. app_user unique auth_provider + auth_subject. app_role unique role_code. | FK grant -> user/role/scope. Check valid_until is null or >= valid_from. | app_user(auth_provider, auth_subject); grant(user_id, role_id, scope_id, valid_until); event(grant_id, occurred_at DESC). | Proposal
Organisation and positions | organisation unique org_code. position_catalog unique position_code. | Self FK organisation parent rejects self-parent. Check assignment effective_to >= effective_from. | organisation(parent_organisation_id); assignment(organisation_id, position_id, effective_from DESC); assignment(person_id, effective_from DESC). | Proposal
One current assignment | No duplicate overlapping active person/position/org assignment. | Proposal: PostgreSQL daterange/tstzrange exclusion constraint where business rule is confirmed; do not enforce inferred hierarchy semantics. | GiST index supporting range exclusion; status event(entity FK, effective_at DESC). | Proposal
Exam and application | exam_program unique program_code. application unique candidate_id + session_id. centre unique centre_code. | FK application -> candidate/session/centre. Check selected centre belongs to permitted session/org only after rule confirmation. | application(candidate_id, session_id); application(session_id, centre_id); status_event(application_id, occurred_at DESC). | Proposal
Documents and imports | document integrity_ref unique when populated. import_row_error unique job_id + row_number + error_code + field_name. | Binary is absent from PostgreSQL. Check object state/category against controlled enumerations. | document(storage_key); import_job(submitted_by_user_id, created_at DESC); row_error(job_id, row_number). | Confirmed
Legal and approval | legal_source stable internal identifier; source-version unique source_id + version_label. | Effective range checks only; no law name/section is invented. source absent remains TO VERIFY. | source_version(source_id, effective_from DESC); mapping(topic_code, review_state); review(mapping_id, occurred_at DESC). | Needs Legal Review
Audit | audit_event UUID PK and immutable sequence/timestamp combination. | Check action code/outcome enum. Cross-domain entity_type/entity_id is a controlled-reference exception, not a universal FK. | audit(actor_user_id, occurred_at DESC); audit(entity_type, entity_id, occurred_at DESC); audit(request_id). | Confirmed
Index note: confirm actual query patterns and PostgreSQL EXPLAIN results after implementation; no performance assertion is made by this design.
8 History Transactions and Retention
Concern | Required implementation rule | Tables affected | Status
Append-only history | Insert a later event for correction, revocation, reinstatement or term change. Do not UPDATE/DELETE earlier business history. Current state is a view/query over valid latest event. | organisation_status_event; position_assignment_status_event; exam_centre_status_event; application_status_event; user_role_scope_event; legal_review_event; approval_decision_event; audit_event | Confirmed
Atomic decision write | A protected mutation commits business row, status/history event, approval reference and audit event together. On failure, roll back all related writes. | All protected mutations and audit_event | Confirmed
Server authorisation | Server evaluates user, role, action, purpose and scope before read, export, history query or mutation. UI/client claims never grant access. | app_user through user_role_scope_grant; access_scope; protected domain tables | Confirmed
Document boundary | Private object storage holds file bytes. PostgreSQL stores minimal document_record metadata, integrity reference and explicit FK links. | document_record and link tables | Confirmed
Retention | Do not hard-code a legal/official retention period. Store retention_policy_ref and disposition state only after DPO/legal/owner decision; preserve disposal evidence as event. | Documents, audit, imports, legal evidence and private person/candidate data | Needs Legal Review
Public projection | Build a separate release-gated read model. Do not query private tables directly from public route and do not expose relationship keys/history/audit/free text. | Projection outside core tables; source tables remain private | Needs Legal Review
9 Failure Modes and Recovery
Failure mode | Detection and containment | Recovery | Status
Missing scope or role grant | Server cannot resolve current valid grant for action/target. | Fail closed with safe 403/not-found; log permitted metadata; request authorised grant change. | Confirmed
Event insert or audit insert fails | Transaction does not complete atomically. | Roll back business mutation; show action failure; reconcile only from committed latest state. | Confirmed
Source/legal evidence absent | Mapping/source-version remains TO VERIFY. | Block authority/release action needing verified evidence; append reviewer outcome when evidence arrives. | Needs Legal Review
Suspected real data in import/document | Synthetic marker, validation or reviewer flags input. | Quarantine private object, stop processing, notify designated owner/DPO/legal reviewer; do not certify outcome. | Needs Legal Review
Overlapping assignment detected | Range/exclusion constraint or service validation rejects write. | Do not overwrite existing assignment; create a correction/decision workflow after owner review. | Proposal
10 Normalisation and History Review Checklist
Review item | Pass condition | Current design result
First normal form | Atomic fields; repeating contacts, documents, grants and status records use separate tables. | Mapped
Second normal form | Association tables use keys and fields dependent on the association, not copied parent attributes. | Mapped
Third normal form | Person, position, organisation, role, scope, program, session and status facts are separated to avoid transitive duplication. | Mapped
Person position separation | Position assignment links person + position + organisation. Person does not carry current office/role/contact duplicates. | Mapped
Event history | Status/decision/review/grant/audit corrections append events; no normal overwrite path. | Mapped
Explicit document relationships | Application, legal source and approval attachments use separate FK link tables, avoiding generic polymorphic attachment ownership. | Mapped
Controlled reference exceptions | approval_decision_event and audit_event use target/entity type + id for cross-domain references; this exception is documented and constrained in service code. | Mapped
Required domains | Users, roles, scopes, people/private/contacts, orgs, positions, history, status, legal, exam, candidate, application, docs, import and audit included. | Mapped
Verification note: the executed review checks this logical catalogue and relationship coverage only. No PostgreSQL migration, Prisma schema, database constraint, SQL transaction, retention job, authorisation policy or product test has been executed or certified.
